claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Ibiden 或其他 IC 載板廠的一手寫出玻纖布再度短缺、或第三、四家供應商量產延後；或寫出玻纖布已完全不構成採購風險。核查頻率：每季（Ibiden 決算 Q&A、景碩、欣興、南電法說）。觸發後 48 小時：重讀 T-glass 布層的「量」與時鐘。
claims.statement: Ibiden (IC package substrate maker, a buyer of glass cloth), Q1 FY2026 Q&A: the glass cloth supply outlook improved mainly because of more suppliers—previously only two in Japan and Taiwan, now prospects of a third and fourth supplier for mass production—and a Japanese supplier is increasing capacity until next fiscal year, so material procurement risk is expected to decrease; substrate demand itself will continue to significantly exceed industry supply. Customer-side statement; suppliers unnamed.

source_doc.title: Ibiden（IC 載板廠）FY2026 第 1 季決算 Key Q&A：玻纖布供應展望改善——以前日台只有兩家，現在可望有第三、四家可量產，日本供應商擴產到下年度；載板需求仍將大幅超過業界供給

sources.quote: [Q] Compared to the beginning of the fiscal year, the forecast for glass cloth supply seems to have improved. What are the main reasons for this improvement? [A] The biggest factor is the increase in the number of suppliers. Previously, there were only two suppliers in Japan and Taiwan, but we now have prospects for using a third and fourth supplier for mass production. Furthermore, a Japanese supplier plans to increase production capacity until the next fiscal year, so we expect material procurement risks to decrease.
Currently, we are receiving inquiries for large, high-multilayer IC package substrates from all customers. We believe that demand will continue to significantly exceed the industry's supply capacity.
